title: Proving the case on day two at TechEx North America
summary: Conference coverage from TechEx North America day two focusing on the challenge of moving AI pilots from proof-of-concept to production systems. The event addressed the 'AI graveyard' phenomenon where many AI projects fail to become durable enterprise systems.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of proving AI implementation value and avoiding the common failure of AI pilots becoming production systems.
why_valuable: Provides insights into enterprise AI adoption challenges and strategies for achieving measurable ROI in AI implementations.
